# Week 10 build notes: Capstone week 1 (Northgate Supply Co.)

Light week: three short talks, the rest is work. Plan: `docs/build/week10.js` (`COURSE_STAGING[10]`).

## Files
- `course-w10-lessons.js`: talks 10.1 (zero trust, 825 words, 4 checks), 10.2 (CSF 2.0 and the weighted questionnaire, 692 words, 4 checks), 10.3 (kickoff and interviews, 660 words, 4 checks); `COURSE_QUIZ.w10` (20 questions).
- `course-w10-labs.js`: labs 10.1 Client brief check, 10.2 Network through a zero trust lens, 10.3 April incident through the CSF, 10.4 Questionnaire workbook tour, 10.5 Kickoff briefing, 10.6 Fieldwork plan (hand-in, the Week 10 deliverable), 10.7 Scoring dry run with a practice client.
- `course-w10-practice.js`: `csf-sort-w10` (22 items), `questions-w10` (17 items), `acro-w10` (20 flash cards).
- `course-w10-figures.js`: `w10-castle-zt`, `w10-csf-weights`, `w10-question-types`. Generated by a scratch script (helpers and palette copied from `docs/tools/make_week1_figures.js`); it was not added to `docs/tools/` because this build was limited to the files listed above. Ask if you want it saved as `docs/tools/make_week10_figures.js`.
- `course-w10-mock.js`: `MOCK_W10` (brief, reference key with every auto-check answer, 5 rubricNotes). No model scores: those stay in the instructor model pack outside the public repo.
- `docs/build/week10.js`, this file.

Design decisions
- INT-01 (CEO) moved into Week 10 as the opening interview, so Week 11 holds the other four. Real engagements usually start with the sponsor.
- Lab 10.2's drawing time and the interview-plan writing are separate `mock` blocks with a basis, because the estimator only measures on-page text and charges 1 min per checkpoint. Long written checkpoints and drawings would otherwise be undercounted.
- Added hands-on work to reach the day target: kickoff briefing and delivery (the model pack has a kickoff deck, so kickoffs are part of the MCCoE method), zero trust target sketch, question tagging, partner practice interview.
- Weighted compliance is introduced in Talk 10.2 (formula and one example); CMM and hygiene are left for Week 12.
- Deliverable = Lab 10.6 (Lab.html saves to `mccoe_course/{key}/labs/10.6`). No new Firebase path.

## Legacy material absorbed
- Legacy week 9 Lesson 1 (Security Architecture and Zero Trust) -> Talk 10.1. Lesson 2 (CSF 2.0 and the weighted questionnaire) -> Talk 10.2. Lesson 3, interview paragraph -> Talk 10.3 (evidence, scans, and contradictions are Week 11).
- Legacy week 9 labs step 1 (read the brief) -> brief block + Lab 10.1; step 2 (plan open questions) -> plan block + Lab 10.6. Steps 3-8 are Weeks 11-12.
- Legacy week 9 quiz: zero trust (5), CSF functions/Govern (2), weight, level order, Mostly value, informal practice level, why one function per question, open question, ask for proof: all 14 rewritten into the Week 10 quiz; 6 new scenario questions added (April path, weighted calc, Recover, one-attempt interviews, leading question, kickoff). The remaining legacy week 9 questions (evidence, Nmap, Nessus, CVSS, scoring math) belong to Weeks 11-12.
- Legacy key terms (security architecture, defense in depth, zero trust, least privilege, CSF, function, weight, weighted compliance, compliance level) are in the talks' keyTerms or tables.
- Legacy resources: SP 800-207, CSWP 29, CISA ZTMM are `read` blocks; Messer zero trust page and the five videos (IBM architecture, Messer zero trust, NIST CSF 2.0, Messer controls, Messer gap analysis) are in `anytime`.
- Dropped: nothing. (The Messer controls and gap analysis videos are optional only.)

## New facts
- No new Northgate facts. Everything comes from `materials/week9/` and `interviews/`.
- New practice-only example (not Northgate): Lab 10.7's "20-person dental office" with five evidence snippets (MFA 20/20 enforced; restore tests claimed with no record; training 11 of 20; one-page unapproved IR draft; 9 of 10 laptops encrypted). Weights 10, 9, 8, 10, 6; answer 48.8%.
- Lab 10.4 uses "test answers" for Q29-Q33 (Fully, Mostly, Fully, Not Compliant, Somewhat = 56.1%) that students must delete. They are not Northgate's scores.

## Shared-file changes needed
1. `course-data.js`: replace the week 10 entry (`legacy: 9`) with this staging plan when approved.
2. Tracker: a grading view for `w10` reading `mccoe_course/{key}/labs/10.1, 10.2, 10.5, 10.6` with `MOCK_W10.rubricNotes`; also show `mccoe_interviews/{id}/INT-01`.
3. `Lesson.html`: optional new callout kind for the client scenario (for example `client` labelled "At Northgate"). Week 10 puts Northgate points in the talk body and uses `tip`, `real`, and `exam` callouts only.
4. `interview.html`: text "Plan your questions first (Week 9 lab, step 2)" and "The interviews open with Week 9" should say Week 10, Lab 10.6.
5. `materials/week9/*.html`: footers say "12-Week Cybersecurity Program", and the brief says "This week you do the fieldwork ... Next week (Week 10)". These now span Weeks 10-13.
6. `docs/tools/estimate_time.js`: `practice()` checks `p.mode === 'flash'` but sets use `kind: 'flash'`, so flash sets are estimated at the sort rate (0.6 min/card, not 0.25). `acro-w10` is in `anytime` only, so no Week 10 block is affected.
